english.title: Manufacture a handgun - prohibited weapon
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, manufactured a firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY FIREARM..), which

(A)_[had a barrel less than 30 centimetres (approx 12 inches) in length]_
(B)_[was less than 60 centimetres (approx 24 inches) in length overall]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(aba) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) This does not apply to an air weapon, muzzle-loading gun or firearm designed as signalling apparatus.
(ii) Any detachable, folding, retractable or other moveable butt-stock is disregarded when measuring the length of the firearm, section 5(8).
(iii) See sections 2 to 8 of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1997 for special exemptions.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H6132, H6133 and H6135.
(v) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Maximum ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
